home.title: Get notified when something important happens
home.description: Set up alerts for the news you care about, and we tell you when it happens.

rules.title: Your topics
rules.text: Choose categories and keywords, so you only get the news that matters to you.

channels.title: Email or Slack
channels.text: Get alerts where you already work: in your inbox or in a Slack channel.

frequency.title: Your timing
frequency.text: Get each alert right away, or one summary per hour or per day.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected error happened. Please try again.
